items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Barry is delightful, fun to work with, easy. I was asked to do this album in an elevator in Osaka.

ctx.x: That’s right. What do you remember about that album?
That there was Mercer lyrics – Johnny Mercer lyrics. Barry is delightful, fun to work with, easy. I was asked to do this album in an elevator in Osaka.
